title: AgentSkillPolicy.v1
description: The skill-governance contract for an agent run on the shared plane. Deny-by-default: a skill must appear in allowlist to be loadable. progressive_disclosure controls whether skills are revealed/loaded on demand rather than all at once. agent_created_skills_status is pinned const 'candidate' — a skill an agent creates is ALWAYS a candidate, never auto-active; requires_eval_before_active forces it through evaluation/promotion before it can be served or reused as active. The agent PROPOSES skills; Baltor DISPOSES (gates promotion).

allowlist.description: skill ids the agent MAY load; anything not listed is denied (deny-by-default)

progressive_disclosure.description: when true, skills are disclosed/loaded on demand rather than all up front

agent_created_skills_status.description: ALWAYS 'candidate' — a skill created by an agent is never born active; it enters the candidate ladder

requires_eval_before_active.description: when true, an agent-created/loaded skill must pass evaluation/promotion before it can become active or be served
